messages:
Ana (marketing): Quick sync before embargo lift. Need one-line changelog, docs anchor, RSVP URL, benchmark soundbite, and inbound routing mapping. Who can confirm canary?
Dev (eng): Canary Wed 09:00 PT for 3h. Ramp 10%->50%->100%. Auto-rollback if error rate >3% or p95 > SLO.
Ana (marketing): Great. Dev, short changelog line we can use?
Dev (eng): "Adaptive KV caching reduces p95 token latency by ~15% on long contexts." Bullets: OOM fix during high-concurrency batching; regional fallback routing.
Oli (product): Messaging suggestion: "Faster, more reliable inference for long histories" — keep it concise.
Rae (docs): Docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.2. Changelog anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.2#changelog. Quickstart snippet added.
Ana (marketing): Can you paste the tiny snippet for the blog?
Rae (docs): ```
client.configure({cache:'adaptive', batching:true})
```
Mina (salesops): Routing: RSVPs -> SFDC campaign "v2_3_launch"; employee_count>500 -> AE queue "Enterprise-APAC"; others -> SDR nurture. I'll push test mapping.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary at 1719010800. Dashboard: https://infra.redwood.ai/deploys/xyz
Mina (salesops): Test RSVP done, campaign tag applied, AE queue mapping okay.
Ana (marketing): We'll stagger sends: email wave +30m and +3h; social at +1h. Avoid heavy link spikes first 20m per Dev.
Dev (eng): We'll monitor charts and post a short runbook with rollback command prior to canary.
Ana (marketing): Thanks all — drafting announcement now and will post in #marketing-drafts in 90m for signoff.
